title: OrgDevice.Relationships
description:
The relationships you include in the request, and those that you can operate on.

Introduced in Apple Business API 2.6.

activationLockStatus.description: The relationship representing a device and its Activation Lock status.

appleCareCoverage.description: The relationship representing a device and its AppleCare coverage.

assignedServer.description: The relationship representing a device and its assigned device management service.
